historical_winner.text:
Create a highly engaging 15–18 second vertical 9:16 Pompom Hills Instagram Reel.

Use the official existing Pompom Hills character references exactly.
MAIN CHARACTER: KIKO

Do not redesign Kiko.
Do not replace her with a generic child.

SERIES:
Pompom English — What’s Wrong?

CORE ENGLISH:
CHAIR
UP
DOWN
“It’s upside down!”

SETTING:
Bright Pompom Hills playroom or garden patio.
Keep the environment simple and instantly readable.

--------------------------------------------------
0.0–0.8 SEC — HARD SCROLL-STOP HOOK
--------------------------------------------------

Start immediately.

Kiko runs toward a chair to sit down.

BUT THE CHAIR IS COMPLETELY UPSIDE DOWN.

Legs pointing into the air.

Kiko is already halfway into the sitting motion before noticing.

She freezes inches above it.

Eyes huge.

She blurts:

“WHAT?!”

NO establishing shot.
The upside-down chair must dominate the first frame.

--------------------------------------------------
0.8–3.5 SEC
--------------------------------------------------

Kiko points:

“A CHAIR!”

Then looks confused.

She says clearly:

“It’s upside down!”

She grabs the chair and flips it correctly.

--------------------------------------------------
3.5–6.0 SEC
--------------------------------------------------

Kiko smiles proudly.

“Up… down!”

She points upward while saying UP.
Then downward while saying DOWN.

She turns around to sit.

--------------------------------------------------
6.0–8.5 SEC — FIRST ESCALATION
--------------------------------------------------

The instant Kiko turns away—

FLIP!

The chair turns upside down by itself.

Kiko sits toward empty space and catches herself at the last second.

She spins around.

--------------------------------------------------
8.5–11.5 SEC
--------------------------------------------------

Kiko flips it back.

She stares directly at the chair.

Chair stays normal.

Kiko slowly turns her head away.

FLIP!

She immediately looks back.

Chair is upside down.

--------------------------------------------------
11.5–14.5 SEC — COMEDY PAYOFF
--------------------------------------------------

Kiko becomes determined.

She keeps staring at the chair.

She slowly walks backward toward it without looking away.

She says:

“Stay DOWN!”

The chair behaves.

Kiko smiles.

--------------------------------------------------
14.5–17.0 SEC — TWIST + LOOP
--------------------------------------------------

Kiko finally sits.

The ENTIRE chair suddenly flips upside down WITH Kiko on it.

Kiko ends upside down and shouts:

“AGAIN?!”

Cut immediately.

Loop back to the first upside-down chair.

--------------------------------------------------
MANDATORY SPOKEN DIALOGUE / LIP-SYNC LOCK
--------------------------------------------------

Exact English dialogue REQUIRED:

Kiko:
“WHAT?!”

Kiko:
“A CHAIR!”

Kiko:
“It’s upside down!”

Kiko:
“Up… down!”

Kiko:
“Stay DOWN!”

Kiko:
“AGAIN?!”

All lines must be clearly audible English.

Visible mouth movement.
Accurate lip-sync.

Do not:
- remove dialogue
- translate it
- replace dialogue with subtitles
- create a silent version
- add narration

--------------------------------------------------
INSTAGRAM RETENTION RULES
--------------------------------------------------

Something must change every 1–2 seconds.

The problem must be understandable without sound.

Do not make the chair movement subtle.

Chair flips must be fast and visually obvious.

No moral lesson.
No slow ending.
No waiting after final joke.
No text generated inside scene.
